 Order
% 11.03.2024
1.
The learned counsel appearing for the Land Acquisition Collector (LAC) seeks further time to get instructions.

2. The petitioner has filed the present petition, inter alia, praying that directions be issued to the respondent to pay compensation against the acquired land described as the land measuring two Bigha 11 Biswa and 14 Biswansi comprising in Khasra No.31//24 min (0-8-7), 31//25 min (2-3-7) in Village Barwala, Delhi.
3. The petitioner claims that the said land was acquired pursuant to a notification dated 25.11.2009 issued under Section 4 of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894.
The said notification was followed by declaration on 19.02.2010 under Section 6 and 17(1) of the said Act.

The award (Award No.03/10-11)
was made on 28.06.2011.

4. It is noticed that the petitioner is a senior citizen of an advanced stage (82 years) and the respondent cannot be given repeated extended time to obtain instructions and file the response.
5. A final opportunity is granted to the respondent to file a counter- affidavit within a period of two weeks from date.
Rejoinder, if any, be filed before the next date of hearing.
6. The LAC is directed to be present in the Court along with the relevant documents in order to ensure that the decision in the matter is not delayed any further.

7. List on 15.04.2024.
